create_zero_shot_re_dataset: create a ZeroShotREDataset instance with name, input file, output file, and max chunks parameters
map_datapoint_to_kilt_entry: map a wikidata relation and question template to a KILT entry with Wikipedia provenance
process_chunk_of_tsv_data: process a chunk of tab-separated zero-shot RE data lines into KILT format entries
get_chunks_from_input_file: read and split the input TSV file into numbered chunks for parallel processing
postprocess_metadata_for_dataset: postprocess and aggregate metadata across chunks to report missing pages and negative samples
